name: everglade-kit-bake
description: The kit town's offline-baked light layers (sky, four suns, and lamps): baked by verse-bake --layers from the Everglade pack with the licensed kit pack installed, outside the repository. Only its digest and length are pinned, in everglade_pack/kit_bake.rs; it regenerates only on a machine with the pinned kit pack, and a CPU bake takes about half an hour.
regenerate: VERSE_KIT_PACK="$HOME/.openagents/verse/private/medieval-town/packs/$(sed -n 's/^pub const KIT_SHA256: &str = "\(.*\)";/\1/p' crates/verse-zone-everglade/src/zones/everglade_pack/kit.rs).vtp" cargo run --release -p verse-bake --features everglade -- --everglade assets/verse/everglade/*.vtp --layers --out "$HOME/.openagents/verse/private/medieval-town/bakes"
check: VERSE_KIT_PACK="$HOME/.openagents/verse/private/medieval-town/packs/$(sed -n 's/^pub const KIT_SHA256: &str = "\(.*\)";/\1/p' crates/verse-zone-everglade/src/zones/everglade_pack/kit.rs).vtp" cargo run --release -p verse-bake --features everglade -- --everglade assets/verse/everglade/*.vtp --layers --check --out "$HOME/.openagents/verse/private/medieval-town/bakes"
message: Repin the Everglade kit light layers with {changes}
